svg.title: THE 24-CHAMBER CYLINDER
svg.desc: THE 24-CHAMBER CYLINDER. One permanent hand. Twenty-four chambers. Exactly one mounted at a time.. Radial diagram of 24 chambers around a central mount; each chamber is labelled with its number, its discipline and its brief size. Full data also given as a table in the page text.
svg.text: One permanent hand. Twenty-four chambers. Exactly one mounted at a time.
A chamber with no live-researched brief does not fire. 241 action items across 24 briefs; group colour marks the discipline family.
